reviews_h2: What people are saying about the tree service

reviews.author: michael fry
reviews.text: Amazing owner and team! Robin is very honest person and the prices were more than fair. I will definitely use them again, they know their business

reviews.author: Peggy Sicheneder
reviews.text: Sands Tree Service was recommended by several people and they did an outstanding job; met and exceeded all expectations! Very professional and courteous! I’m definitely using their services again!

reviews.author: Gayla Warrener
reviews.text: Sands Tree Service could not have been better. They dropped five mature River Birches, three leaning over a new roof. Their 8 or so person team was highly coordinated and led by two very experienced TLs who communicated to the team via wireless helmets. Because of their expertise, coordination and professionalism, they were done in one hour dropping the trees, as my family is doing the clean up. Sands was amazing to watch and were very reasonably priced. My family and I highly recommend them and will definitely use them again!
